articles.title: Margaret Iwasaki, 80, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Margaret Iwasaki for the many years of service to Lower Millrace.
body: Margaret Iwasaki died in March at home on Beacon Place, at the age of 80. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Lower Millrace.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Millrace Library branch in his or her name.
Born in Lower Millrace in the years after the war, Margaret Iwasaki spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
